title: The training infrastructure behind AI-Powered Job Search: 8X faster multi-teacher distillation
summary: Eliminates teacher inference reruns on every student retrain by caching each teacher's outputs per data shard.

title: Faster than Light: Optimizing Generative Recommender Training Efficiency at LinkedIn
summary: Cuts padding waste from skewed user sequences by packing them, since dynamic batching biased recommender training.

title: The 58-Million-Key Freeze: What a HashMap Resize Taught Us About Memory Allocation at Scale
summary: Traces FishDB freezes to a HashMap resize whose mmap held mmap_lock and froze Tokio, fixed by pre-sizing the map.

title: Engineering the next generation of LinkedIn's Feed
summary: Replaces siloed Feed retrieval sources with an LLM dual encoder and per-post ranking with a sequential transformer.

title: Scaling LLM-Based ranking systems with SGLang at LinkedIn
summary: Removes decode loops and per-item query prefill from SGLang ranking via a scoring path that reuses query KV in-batch.

title: Scaling maintenance: Rethinking HDFS block placement for exabyte-scale clusters
summary: Moves HDFS off rack placement, which forced re-replication before maintenance, to upgrade domains of whole racks.

title: Reimagining LinkedIn’s search tech stack
summary: Scales relevance grading past manual review with a product-policy LLM judge whose labels train retrieval and ranking.

title: Turbocharging LinkedIn’s recommendation systems with SGLang
summary: Swaps per-item prompts repeating the member prefix for multi-item prompts under an item-isolating FlashInfer mask.

title: Scalable, Multi-language Service Discovery at LinkedIn
summary: Ends ZooKeeper read storms that dropped sessions by moving endpoint writes to Kafka and reads to Go Observers over xDS.

title: Introducing Northguard and Xinfra: scalable log storage at LinkedIn
summary: Ends Kafka's partition-level load skew with Northguard, which gives each log segment its own replica set.

title: Stateful Workload Operator: Stateful Systems on Kubernetes at LinkedIn
summary: Fills StatefulSet's gaps in shard safety and host maintenance with one shared operator gated on per-app manager acks.

title: Java heap memory and garbage collection: tuning for high-performance services
summary: Fixes G1 tail-latency spikes on FollowFeed's huge heap by flattening Avro objects and moving to generational ZGC.

title: Reducing Apache Spark Application Dependencies Upload by 99%
summary: Stops Spark jobs from re-uploading the same JARs each run with a per-user HDFS cache, chosen over YARN Shared Cache.

title: Opal: Building a mutable dataset in data lake
summary: Replaces Lumos merges, which rewrote files and delayed snapshots, with Opal's read-time filtering by validity bitmaps.

title: Scaling LinkedIn's Hadoop YARN cluster beyond 10,000 nodes
summary: Fixes YARN job delays from starved queues and partition-blind heartbeat scans, then splits the cluster behind Robin.

title: Homepage feed multi-task learning using TensorFlow
summary: Merges per-objective models, whose latency grew with each objective, into one network with passive and active towers.

title: Rebuilding messaging: How we bootstrapped our platform
summary: Keeps backfill and dual-writes from splitting conversations by hashing old IDs into the same UUID on both paths.
